answers.core: It's a small enhancement to the existing `GodotPhysicsDirectSpaceState2D::intersect_ray` functionality that shouldn't be terribly difficult to implement given an understanding of how to work with that code.
answers.workaround: One work-around would be to iteratively check collision points further away until you exit the shape, then cast a ray from the point you found back toward the start point.  However, this wouldn't be nearly as efficient as just casting a ray, and it could be error-prone too if you end up skipping over small gaps in your search.

title: Let `PhysicsDirectSpaceState2D.intersect_ray()` find the edge of the collision shape it's inside of
